newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments up on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments up on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1, 1996 and January 14, 1997, were 36.6 percent above their year-ago level, mostly the result of higher wheat and barley sales, member-country officials said on Friday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain exports at 17.612 million tonnes against 12.891 million last year.
Commercial soft wheat export commitments reached 6.078 million tonnes, up from 4.292 million in the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports jumped to 3.551 million tonnes from 1.223 million during the same period last year, helped by sales to Saudi Arabia.
Flour exports were also ahead at 3.826 million tonnes against 3.007 million.
Malt exports rose to 2.452 million tonnes from 2.187 million.

Since January 14, the EU has authorised 343,100 tonnes of soft wheat, 172,500 tonnes of barley, 6,201 tonnes of rye, 42,000 tonnes of oats exports through its weekly grain export tender system. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
